datasets.name: High-resolution DEM of the Mengu landslide
datasets.source: Authors' own airborne LiDAR data processing
datasets.verbatim: The study area utilized a high-resolution DEM of 0.2 m. ... This completes the acquisition and processing of airborne LiDAR data for the study area.

methods.name: LiDAR image highlighting algorithm (LIHA)
methods.summary: LIHA enhances micro-topographical features in DEMs by treating terrain profiles as non-stationary spectral signals. It segments the DEM into profiles, applies LOESS smoothing to extract trends, uses discrete wavelet transform (DWT) to decompose the differential signal into low-frequency and high-frequency components, amplifies the high-frequency components, and reconstructs the enhanced DEM.
methods.source: Qiulin He, Xiujun Dong, Haoliang Li, Bo Deng and Jingsong Sima
methods.verbatim: Based on the above research methodology and data preprocessing, this study utilized the programming platform Matlab 2020a to construct the LIHA.

availability.author_statement: The raw data supporting the conclusions of this article will be made available by the authors on request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not referenced or linked, and the custom LIHA code is not provided in a repository or persistent link.
